claim: How It Differs From Standard Delay §: it thinks in phrases, 'here's what you just did, replayed', not 'echo, echo, echo'. Latent tension in The Core Architecture §: the gain knob 'multiplies the write amplitude' yet is said to summon the past phrase — material written at gain 0 is never recorded, so raising the knob can only summon what was written while it was up; a piece would show which.
